# Data Sets

Datasets split a data source into segments that *digna* monitors separately. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/data-sets` | [List data sets](#get-data-sets) |
| `POST` | `/v1/data-sets` | [Create a data set](#create-data-set) |
| `GET` | `/v1/data-sets/{dataset_id}` | [Get a data set](#get-data-set) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/data-sets/{dataset_id}` | [Update a data set](#update-data-set) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/data-sets/{dataset_id}` | [Delete a data set](#delete-data-set) |

---

## List data sets {: #get-data-sets }

```http
GET /v1/data-sets
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data_source_id` | query | integer | Yes | Filter by data source ID |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List data sets | array of [DataSet](#dataset) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/data-sets?data_source_id=<data_source_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

## Create a data set {: #create-data-set }

```http
POST /v1/data-sets
```

**Request body**: [CreateDataSetRequest](#createdatasetrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Create a data set | [DataSet](#dataset) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `403` | Not authorized | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://digna.example.com/v1/data-sets' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "data_source_id": 1,
    "filter_expression": "<filter_expression>",
    "grouping_expression": "<grouping_expression>",
    "kind": "STATIC",
    "name": "<name>"
  }'
```
